يمكنك إرجاع أي منتج غير مستخدم خلال ١٤ ي.en: Measure your foot length in centimetres and match it to the size chart on the style's page. Runners fit true to size and canvas high-tops run a little narrow, so if you are between two sizes take the larger one. If you are unsure, send us the measurement and we will tell you which fits.
